case_number: WRIT PETITION (C) NO. 59 OF 2013; WRIT PETITION (C) NO. 1283 OF 2021

parties.petitioner: Association of Old Settlers of Sikkim and Others

summary: Challenge to validity of Section 10(26AAA) of Income Tax Act, 1961 defining 'Sikkimese'; exclusion of pre-merger Indian settlers and post-2008 married women challenged as discriminatory under Articles 14, 15, 21; historical context of Sikkim's merger examined; distinction between Sikkim Subjects Regulation registrants and other Indian settlers considered; constitutional validity of tax exemption provision upheld based on historical basis for differential treatment.
legal_provisions_cited: Constitution of India Art.14, Art.15, Art.21, Art.371-F
final_judgment: Challenges dismissed; Section 10(26AAA) upheld as constitutionally valid; writ petitions dismissed.
